validation_queries.description: Check that migration events have valid timestamps
validation_queries.error_message: No migration events with valid timestamps found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kfd_page_migrate WHERE timestamp > 0

validation_queries.description: Check that migration events have args_str containing agent info
validation_queries.error_message: Migration events missing src_agent or dst_agent in args_str
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kfd_page_migrate WHERE args_str LIKE '%src_agent%' AND args_str LIKE '%dst_agent%'

validation_queries.description: Check that migration events have non-zero size
validation_queries.error_message: No migration events with non-zero size found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kfd_page_migrate WHERE value > 0

required_tables.commit: KFD page fault events table (optional - depends on workload)
required_tables.name: kfd_page_fault

validation_queries.description: If page faults exist, check they have valid timestamps
validation_queries.error_message: Page fault events found but with invalid timestamps
validation_queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kfd_page_fault WHERE timestamp > 0) END FROM kfd_page_fault
